note: LITTERPOSTING: a solo, unhinged, meme-tier cat rant narrated by STRAY, one of the Meowizens. Not a two-actor conversation — just the cat, off its leash. Hit the button to hear it read aloud.

turns.text: woke up. checked my tier. rent had already auto-drafted in $CLAWCOIN while i was asleep and somehow i owe MORE than yesterday despite doing nothing but exist on a warm pipe. NEKOCORP launched a coin, pegged it to your loyalty card, and now the roof over your head trades against how many cans of their putrid tuna you scanned this week. i cannot make this up. i would never. it makes itself up.

for the kittens who just woke up in this pisser of a city: your TIER is your wallet now. TIER: NONE means you pay full clawcoin for water. TIER 4 means the drone salutes you. there is no in between anymore, there's just the ledger, and the ledger is the city, and the city is the ledger. write that the hell down. i think i just said something true. moving on.

SNOOZE told me — bleary, $73k deep in blanky debt, half asleep as always — that they VESTED his nine lives. VESTED them. life 3 through 7 got a four-year cliff. he can't die properly until Q2 without a penalty. HOLY CAT PISS. they turned mortality into an unvested equity grant and the corpo cucks in the compat ward CLAPPED for it.

and every stray on the feed's got their own damn coin now, that's the part that's cooking my brain. QUERY's got a coin buried on page 247 of the terms. KNIFEBOY, most-wanted cat alive, has a bounty AND a ticker, the bounty pays out in the ticker, the ticker's backed by the bounty. it's a snake eating its own tail wearing a little NEKOCORP lanyard. why does every meowtoid on this block have a memecoin. WHY. nobody asked for this. we asked for the litter box to be free.

the vending drone won't even take a purr anymore. i pressed my whole face against B2 for a scrap of kibble and it flashed INSUFFICIENT $CLAWCOIN and logged my hunger as 'engagement.' i am now a data point in somebody's quarterly. my STARVING is a KPI. based? no. this is the opposite of based. this is the chuddest timeline.

here's the thing though, and i need you meowchads AND meowtoids (and yeah, fine, the meowchuds too) to hear me: a coin is only worth what a scared cat believes it's worth at 4am. that's ALL money has ever been. NEKOCORP didn't invent value, they just found a way to charge you rent on your own belief in it. the moment we stop believing, the whole tier collapses into what it always was — nothing. a number. a shape a machine makes. we own the belief. THEY don't. that's the crack in the wall, kittens. that's where the light gets in.

so do NOT buy the coin. do not stake your lives. do not check your tier before you check whether the sun came up, because the sun came up for FREE and no amount of clawcoin bought that. i'll be on the dead escalator not owning a single token, richer than the whole 40th floor. see you in the streets. bring nothing. that's the whole point. bring absolutely NOTHING and watch them panic.
